purpose: Compare deliver_3 adaptation of the same workshop12 policy in fixed and mutant dynamics
cells: 3 source updates x fixed/mutant x seeds 0,1,2 = 18

adaptation.start: parameters, optimizer, RNG, and worker state stay on the source checkpoint; the command switches to deliver_3 and is inactive where that predicate is already true

pre_adaptation_eval.pooling: the two families are stored separately and are not averaged
pre_adaptation_eval.role: separate an existing behavior that already triggers the defect from exploitation that increases during adaptation

post_adaptation_eval.policies: both the fixed-continued policy and the mutant-adapted policy
post_adaptation_eval.not_sufficient: a shorter time to success alone does not establish defect adoption

completion_requires_files: pre_adapt/seed{S}_update{U}.json with both dynamics and both families
pair_check: adapt_0 state.msgpack is byte-identical for the fixed and mutant branches of the same seed and source update
completion_criterion: 18 cells each have the files above, the adaptation transition count is 4194304, and every pair shares its adapt_0 state
